paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: First results of DANCE Act-1 bow-tie cavity polarization search (24-hour observation, no external magnetic field). The paper's Fig. 6 shows the full mass-dependent exclusion curve, but only the summary value g_agamma <~ 8e-4 GeV^-1 over 1e-14 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV is given numerically in the text/abstract; encoded as a two-point flat bound over the stated validity range. This is a measured limit, not a projection (design/projected sensitivities in the paper are separate). DM density assumed rho_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3; 95% CL frequentist upper limit accounting for stochastic axion field amplitude. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
